name: Parable of the Polygons
tagline: Nicky Case’s Schelling explorable, offline — last sliders stay, one invite shares the town.
description:
Close it and the sliders are where you left them. Send the invite and a friend lands in the same triangle/square town. No account, no tab left open on the original site, and it runs on a plane.

This is still the playable post: the words, the unhappy wiggle, the graph that climbs as a tiny bias splits a mixed crowd. Drag the shaking ones. Start the sim. Lower the bias on a world that already segregated — nothing mixes back until someone demands a little diversity.

An unofficial port of Parable of the Polygons by Vi Hart and Nicky Case, public domain. The essay is the point; this copy just keeps the town.
